meta.name: tfx-consensus
meta.description: DEPRECATED — tfx-auto consensus root 로 통합됨. `/tfx-auto --mode consensus` 가 canonical entrypoint 다. Phase 4a 부터 consensus/debate/panel 은 같은 엔진 family 를 공유하고, 차이는 `--shape` 와 renderer 에만 남긴다. Phase 5 (v11) 에 물리 삭제 예정.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改用统一入口执行共识流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用旧版共识命令并收到弃用提示。
copy.tagline_en: Switch to the unified command for consensus workflows.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're using the legacy consensus command and need to move to the new entry point.

howto.what: 装上后，当触发该技能时，Claude 会先记录一条弃用日志，再把你的请求以 consensus（共识）模式转交给 tfx-auto 处理，产出共识分析结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“consensus”“합의”等关键词，或要求进行共识/一致性分析时触发。

say.text: 用 consensus 模式分析这个 PR 能否合并。
对“远程办公的利弊”做个共识分析。
say.note: 触发 tfx-auto consensus 流程。

say.text: 请以 consensus 模式评估这两个方案。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude logs a deprecation entry, then delegates your request to tfx-auto in consensus mode, producing a consensus analysis result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "consensus" or "합의", or ask for a consensus/unanimity analysis.

say_en.text: Use consensus mode to analyze whether this PR can be merged.
Do a consensus analysis on the pros and cons of remote work.
Evaluate these two proposals in consensus mode.
